cap: Cervical findings are sorted by cause. High estrogen everts the columnar lining as ectropion, and metaplasia that seals a gland leaves a harmless nabothian cyst. Scarring narrows the opening and traps blood as hematometra, and chlamydia or gonorrhea cause cervicitis. Invasive carcinoma spreads beside the cervix and compresses the ureters, so bilateral hydronephrosis and renal failure are a leading cause of death.
